_schema.title: Krinner et al., Nature 605, 669 (2022), arXiv:2112.03708: device calibration
_schema.readme: Every leaf quantity is an object {value, units, kind, source, uncertainty, cooldown[, method]}. kind: 'published' (printed number in a paper), 'digitized' (read from a figure: the source names figure/panel/page), 'fitted' (computed by our numpy models: 'method' says how). uncertainty: {sigma, units[, basis/note]} as 1 sigma, or null when no estimate exists. cooldown: a key of 'cooldowns'. Units are SI (Hz, s); flux in flux quanta. Coupling convention: g_11_20 = sqrt(2) J_qq. Top-level sections: cooldowns, coupling, qubits (per-qubit circuit values, flux_quanta_capable flag), flux_line (Hellings 2025 distortion model), cz (per-pair published values + knobs), crosstalk, defects, readout. Published values here duplicate the target only where a calibration consumer needs them alongside fitted values; the target remains the source of truth for published numbers.

cooldowns.K22-main: the cooldown of Krinner22 Tab. I (columns without superscript a) and the QEC data
cooldowns.K22-a: the other cooldown of the same device marked (a) in Krinner22 Tab. I; also Fig. 10 (drive crosstalk)
cooldowns.K22-appE3: Krinner22 App. E3 measurement-induced dephasing run (X1 parked at 4.429 GHz); cooldown not stated
cooldowns.HEL25: the cooldown of Hellings 2025 (X2 tuning curve, flux-line model, X2 CZ at 4.4 GHz); same device
cooldowns.REMM25: the later cooldown of Remm 2025 Tab. I (X1 at its lower sweet spot); same device

coupling.convention: g_11_20 is the |11>-|20> matrix element at the interaction point (auxiliary first); J_qq = g_11_20 / sqrt(2) is the 0-1 exchange. Charge model: H_c = g_c n_A n_D.

feedlines.source: Krinner22 arXiv:2112.03708v1 Fig. 1b (page 2), false-colour micrograph; rasters png/fig1b_300.png and png/fig1b_tr_600.png
feedlines.method: Visual trace of the purple feedlines to the blue Purcell filters at 300/600 dpi (top-left feedline traced: Z1 and D4 filters directly, D7/Z2 filters by proximity), then the remaining qubits partitioned by chip quadrant and checked against Methods B: 4 feedlines of 4-5 qubits with readout resonators ~200 MHz apart within a feedline. Every in-feedline spacing in this partition is >= 150 MHz; uniqueness was checked only for X3 (X3 with Z3 would be 58 MHz apart).

top_left.confidence: high for Z1, D4 (traced); medium for D7, Z2

top_right.confidence: medium (X2-D5 published; rest by quadrant + spacing)

bottom_left.confidence: medium (D9 published; rest by quadrant + spacing)

cross_checks: X2 and D5 share a feedline: Remm 2023 (TWPA, arXiv:2210.04799) App. F - satisfied
D9 is on the 'bottom-left' feedline: Swiadek 2024 (arXiv:2307.07765) Fig. 7 - satisfied (orientation as in Fig. 1b)
